scenarios.title: Open, edit, save, and switch files on a generic locale fixture
scenarios.goal: Verify the ordinary open/edit/save flow on a locale-diverse manual fixture without relying on fake file-close semantics.
scenarios.start_context: Launch the scenario project with RU selected. This is a file-write scenario. Use Project tree file switching because the app does not expose a close-file action.
scenarios.finish_condition: Leave RU/ui.txt active after saving, switching to RU/menu.txt, and switching back, with the edited value still visible and the row clean after save.
operator_hints: This scenario verifies writing the copied fixture to disk, not cache-only save.
If Save prompts for a write or cache decision, choose Write to file and record the exact prompt wording in Notes. If no prompt appears, record that too.
steps: Open RU/ui.txt from the Project tree.
Edit UI_HELLO in the table or detail editor and confirm the row becomes dirty.
Use General -> Save. If a save/write prompt appears, choose Write to file for this scenario and record the prompt wording in Notes. Then open RU/menu.txt from the Project tree.
Switch back to RU/ui.txt and verify the saved value persists.
expected_checks: No startup or save error dialogs appear.
Dirty and clean state changes follow edit then save.
File switching does not break the saved value or active editing context.

scenarios.title: Conflict resolution flow: drop cache, drop original, and merge
scenarios.goal: Verify the full conflict-resolution workflow in one coherent run: Drop cache on RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt, Drop original on RU/conflict_drop_original.txt, then Merge mixed choices plus one edited value on RU/conflict_merge_mixed.txt.
scenarios.start_context: Launch with RU selected. Use the Project tree to move between RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt, RU/conflict_drop_original.txt, RU/conflict_merge_mixed.txt, and RU/ui.txt. RU/ui.txt is only a neutral switch target in this scenario and should not open a conflict dialog.
scenarios.finish_condition: Leave RU/conflict_merge_mixed.txt active after completing all three conflict paths, saving after each apply step, and switching through neutral RU/ui.txt without any repeated conflict prompt.
operator_hints: In this scenario, General -> Save opens the Write original files dialog for cached drafts.
Do not write later conflict files early. If the dialog lists future conflict files, uncheck them or choose Cache only according to the current step.
After Drop cache, RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt is expected to keep file-side values. If it is not listed in Write original files and only later conflict files are listed, choose Cache only.
steps: Open RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt from the Project tree, wait for the conflict dialog, confirm both rows are present, and choose Drop cache.

Use General -> Save. In Write original files, do not write later conflict files. If RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt is not listed and only later conflict files are listed, choose Cache only. If RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt is listed, leave only RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt checked and choose Write. Then open neutral RU/ui.txt, verify it opens without a conflict dialog, switch back to RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt, and verify file-side values remain visible with no second conflict prompt.
Open RU/conflict_drop_original.txt from the Project tree, wait for the conflict dialog, confirm both rows are present, and choose Drop original.

Use General -> Save. In Write original files, leave only RU/conflict_drop_original.txt checked, uncheck RU/conflict_merge_mixed.txt if present, and choose Write. Then open neutral RU/ui.txt, verify it opens without a conflict dialog, switch back to RU/conflict_drop_original.txt, and verify cached values remain visible with no second conflict prompt.
Open RU/conflict_merge_mixed.txt from the Project tree, wait for the conflict dialog, choose Merge, and confirm both MERGE_A and MERGE_B rows are visible.
Select Original for MERGE_A, Cache for MERGE_B, edit one merge value cell before Apply, and then press Apply.

Use General -> Save. In Write original files, leave only RU/conflict_merge_mixed.txt checked and choose Write. Then open neutral RU/ui.txt, verify it opens without a conflict dialog, switch back to RU/conflict_merge_mixed.txt, and verify the mixed choices plus edited merge value remain visible with no second conflict prompt.
expected_checks: Conflict dialog appears immediately for RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt, RU/conflict_drop_original.txt, and RU/conflict_merge_mixed.txt.
Drop cache clears cached draft data and leaves file-side values visible for RU/conflict_drop_cache.txt.
Drop original applies cached values for RU/conflict_drop_original.txt.
Merge requires per-row decisions, allows one edited merge value, and applies the mixed result for RU/conflict_merge_mixed.txt.
Save decisions do not write later unresolved conflict files before their own steps.
RU/ui.txt stays a neutral non-conflicting switch target while save plus file switching remains stable after each conflict path.

scenarios.title: Manual QA run, navigation, and stale-message refresh flow
scenarios.goal: Verify manual QA run progression, finding navigation, stale-message rendering, and findings refresh on a deterministic QA file.
scenarios.start_context: Launch with RU selected and keep the QA side panel visible. Scenario preferences disable QA auto-refresh and QA auto-mark paths.
scenarios.finish_condition: Leave RU/ui.txt active after the second manual QA run, with refreshed findings visible for the edited file and no fake placeholder row in the findings list.
steps: Open RU/ui.txt from the Project tree and confirm the QA panel shows the pre-run manual message.
Press Run QA and observe rule-state progress in fixed order until the run completes.
Activate one finding from the list and confirm the table navigates to the matching row.

Edit one translation that has a QA finding and confirm only that row's stale finding is removed while unrelated findings stay visible and a notice explains that edited rows need QA again because old findings are hidden until rerun.
Press Run QA again and confirm the findings list refreshes for the edited file.
expected_checks: Pre-run QA message indicates manual QA mode for RU/ui.txt.
Rule-state progress follows the queued, running, and completed sequence during the run.
Findings list is non-empty and supports row navigation.
After editing one row, the panel keeps unrelated findings visible and shows `1 edited row needs QA again. Old findings are hidden until you rerun QA.` outside the findings list.
The second run rebuilds the findings list from scratch for the edited file.

scenarios.title: Manual encoding and charset roundtrip verification
scenarios.goal: Verify mixed-charset roundtrip editing across Cp1251, UTF-16, and Cp1252 files without mojibake.
scenarios.start_context: Launch with RU, KO, and PTBR selected. Use Project tree file switching between the three target files.
scenarios.finish_condition: Leave PTBR/IG_UI_PTBR.txt active after switching back through all edited files, with each saved value still readable in its native script.
operator_hints: This is a file-write scenario. If Save offers cache-only versus writing the file, choose Write to file.
If the write flow explains that new lines will be inserted for missing translation rows, record the exact prompt text and continue with the normal file write for this scenario.
Use the status bar to confirm the current file encoding before each save.
steps: Open RU/IG_UI_RU.txt and confirm the status bar shows the current file encoding before editing.
Replace one RU value with a real Cyrillic phrase such as `Сохранить игру`, use General -> Save, and choose Write to file if prompted.
Open KO/IG_UI_KO.txt, confirm the status bar shows the current file encoding, replace one KO value with a real Korean phrase such as `설정을 저장`, then save with Write to file if prompted.

Open PTBR/IG_UI_PTBR.txt, confirm the status bar shows the current file encoding, replace one PT-BR value with a real Cp1252-safe phrase such as `Salvar alterações`, then save with Write to file if prompted.
Switch back through RU/IG_UI_RU.txt, KO/IG_UI_KO.txt, and PTBR/IG_UI_PTBR.txt.
Confirm each edited value remains readable with no mojibake after the roundtrip.
expected_checks: No parse or decode error dialogs appear while opening mixed encodings.
Status bar shows the current file encoding for each opened file.
Edits in Cp1251, UTF-16, and Cp1252 files persist after save.
Returning to the edited files does not show mojibake or broken open-save behavior.

scenarios.title: TM lookup, apply, and panel-stability flow
scenarios.goal: Verify deterministic project TM lookup and apply behavior on a locale-diverse generic fixture.
scenarios.start_context: Launch with RU selected. RU/tm_memory.txt provides the project-TM match source while RU/ui.txt is the active editing file.
scenarios.finish_condition: Leave RU/ui.txt active on the applied row after switching away and back, with the applied translation still visible and the TM panel responsive.
steps: Open RU/ui.txt, switch to the TM side panel, and select the UI_CAMERA row.
Wait for TM suggestions and confirm a project-origin suggestion derived from RU/tm_memory.txt appears.
Apply the suggestion and confirm the translation cell updates under the normal edit pipeline.
Switch to RU/tm_memory.txt or a different row, then return to the applied row in RU/ui.txt.
Verify the applied value persists and the TM panel remains responsive.
expected_checks: TM panel shows at least one project suggestion for the UI_CAMERA row.
Applying the suggestion updates the translation cell without freezing the UI.
The row remains editable and the TM panel still responds after the apply action.

scenarios.title: Source-reference mode with empty source when counterpart is missing
scenarios.goal: Verify source-reference locale switching on files with and without KO counterparts, using empty Source cells when the requested counterpart file is missing.
scenarios.start_context: Launch with RU and KO selected. Keep KO selected as the source-reference locale for the whole scenario. RU/ui.txt has a KO counterpart; RU/menu.txt does not.
scenarios.finish_condition: Leave RU/menu.txt active after selecting KO as the source-reference locale and confirming the Source column stays empty for the missing counterpart without changing the selected source-reference mode.
operator_hints: Do not treat an empty Source cell on RU/menu.txt as a failure in this scenario; the empty state is the intended result when KO/menu.txt is missing.
This scenario verifies `requested source or empty`, not fallback chains. Do not open Preferences or look for automatic fallback behavior here.
steps: Open RU/ui.txt and use the Source column header control to select KO as the source-reference locale.
Confirm the Source column now shows KO text for RU/ui.txt.
Open RU/menu.txt and keep KO selected as the source-reference locale.
Confirm the Source column on RU/menu.txt stays empty because no KO/menu.txt exists.
Change the selected row inside RU/menu.txt and confirm the Source column stays empty there as well.
Switch back to RU/ui.txt and then return to RU/menu.txt to confirm the selected source-reference locale remains stable while the missing counterpart still produces an empty Source column.
expected_checks: Source-reference control responds without errors.
KO source is shown on RU/ui.txt because a KO counterpart exists.
RU/menu.txt keeps an empty Source column rather than showing fallback text when KO/menu.txt is missing.
Switching files does not silently replace the requested KO source-reference mode with another locale.

scenarios.title: Status-comment writeback (opt-in)
scenarios.goal: Verify opt-in TZP status-comment write-back changes only namespaced TZP comments and keeps user comments intact.
scenarios.start_context: Launch with RU selected. Scenario preferences already enable TZP write-back for this copied project. You should not need to change Preferences manually unless you are diagnosing a failure.
scenarios.finish_condition: Leave RU/tzp_status.txt active after saving and switching through RU/ui.txt, with on-disk comments matching the opt-in TZP policy.
operator_hints: Use the dialog copy buttons to copy the project root or inspection paths before checking the file on disk.
This scenario verifies an on-disk file write, not cache-only save. If Save offers both, choose Write to file.
Record exactly which comment lines changed if the on-disk result differs from expectation.
steps: Open RU/tzp_status.txt. In row `TZP_KEEP`, change the translation to `Готово к выпуску` and change the row status from For Review to Translated.
Use General -> Save. If Save offers both cache-only and file-write options, choose Write to file for this scenario.
Use the dialog copy buttons to copy the project root or inspection path, then open the copied inspection file RU/tzp_status.txt under the scenario project root.
Confirm `TZP_KEEP` now ends with the namespaced comment `-- TZP:TRANSLATED` on disk.
Confirm `TZP_EDIT` still keeps only the user-authored comment `-- заметка переводчика` and did not gain a new TZP comment.
Switch to RU/ui.txt and back to RU/tzp_status.txt to confirm normal editing flow still works.
expected_checks: Scenario-injected TZP write-back is active for this copied project without extra preference edits.
`TZP_KEEP` updates its namespaced TZP comment from FOR_REVIEW to TRANSLATED.
`TZP_EDIT` keeps the user-authored non-TZP comment unchanged.

scenarios.title: Search+replace sidebar flow with all replace scopes
scenarios.goal: Verify Search sidebar controls stay synchronized with the toolbar while File, Locale, and Locale Pool replace scopes run through the replace-all confirmation flow.
scenarios.start_context: Launch with RU and KO selected. Preferences start Replace scope at File; use the Confirm Replace All dialog's transient Replace scope selector for this scenario and do not persist scope changes.
scenarios.finish_condition: Leave RU/search_scope.txt active after canceling File and Locale Pool previews, then applying Locale scope so RU/search_scope.txt and RU/search_scope_extra.txt changed while KO/search_scope.txt stayed unchanged.
steps: Open RU/search_scope.txt, switch to the Search panel, enter search text `target word`, and enter replacement text `release word`.
Confirm toolbar and sidebar search controls stay synchronized in both directions.
Run Replace All with dialog Replace scope set to File, review the confirmation dialog counts/preview, and cancel it.
Run Replace All again, change the dialog Replace scope to Locale Pool, confirm the counts/preview update live, and cancel it.
Run Replace All again, change the dialog Replace scope to Locale, confirm the counts/preview update live, tick the review checkbox, and apply the replacement.
Open RU/search_scope_extra.txt and KO/search_scope.txt to confirm both RU files changed to `release word` while KO/search_scope.txt still contains `target word`.
expected_checks: Toolbar and sidebar search controls remain synchronized in both directions.
Confirm Replace All is wide enough to read the per-file list and impact preview.
Replace All confirmation appears for File, Locale, and Locale Pool when matches exist, and dialog scope changes update counts/preview live.
Canceled runs make no edits.
The applied Locale run changes RU/search_scope.txt and RU/search_scope_extra.txt, but not KO/search_scope.txt.
Changing Replace scope inside Confirm Replace All does not persist the Preferences replace scope.

scenarios.title: Search+replace impact preview with checkbox-gated replace safety
scenarios.goal: Verify the replace-all impact preview, row ordering, cancel path, and checkbox-gated apply flow with a real multi-file pool scope.
scenarios.start_context: Launch with RU and KO selected. Set Replace scope through General -> Preferences -> Search / Replace before running Replace All.
scenarios.finish_condition: Leave RU/search_scope.txt active after a canceled run and a confirmed pool run, with the replacement persisted across the expected files.
steps: Open RU/search_scope.txt, switch to the Search panel, and set query target word plus replacement target phrase.
Open General -> Preferences -> Search / Replace, set Replace scope to Locale Pool, apply the dialog, and run Replace All.
Inspect the confirmation summary and row-level impact preview, then cancel and confirm no values change.
Run Replace All again, verify the Replace button stays disabled until the review checkbox is checked, then tick it and apply the replacement.
Switch between RU/search_scope.txt, RU/search_scope_extra.txt, and KO/search_scope.txt to confirm the replacement persisted across the expected files.
expected_checks: Confirmation dialog shows scope label, total replacements, affected files, and row-level preview rows.
Replace stays disabled until the review checkbox is checked.
The cancel path leaves files unchanged.
The confirmed pool replace persists across all expected files after file switching.

scenarios.title: B42 JSON open, edit, source-reference, and save roundtrip
scenarios.goal: Verify a synthetic B42 JSON locale opens with its matching EN source, preserves escaped values, and writes only the edited translation value on explicit Save.
scenarios.start_context: Launch with BE selected. This scenario uses only synthetic strings and writes only the copied scenario project.
scenarios.finish_condition: Leave BE/UI.json active after saving one edited value and confirming the copied BE/UI.json remains valid JSON with the other values unchanged.
operator_hints: This is a file-write scenario. If Save offers cache-only versus writing the file, choose Write to file.
Use the dialog copy action for the project root before inspecting BE/UI.json; never inspect or edit the installed game's files for this scenario.
steps: Open BE/UI.json and confirm the Source column contains the matching EN values.
Inspect the escaped multiline/quote row in the detail panel and confirm it renders as text rather than raw JSON escapes.
Edit only UI_fixture_greeting, then use General -> Save and choose Write to file if prompted.
Inspect the copied BE/UI.json and confirm the edited greeting is present while UI_fixture_escaped and UI_fixture_unicode remain unchanged.
Return to BE/UI.json in the app and confirm all three rows remain readable.
expected_checks: The locale opens without a charset or parse warning even though B42 language.txt omits charset.
Source reference, escaped text, Unicode text, and row order are correct.
Save changes only the selected JSON value and does not rewrite unrelated formatting or values.
A format-distinct BE/UI.json.bin draft cache is used and no legacy UI.bin collision occurs.

scenarios.title: Local committed EN synchronization through preview and Save
scenarios.goal: Verify a committed EN value, comment, and new key are previewed from local HEAD, applied to cache without changing the target original, and written only by normal Save.
scenarios.start_context: Launch with RU selected. Use the copy-project-root button and a separate terminal to initialize and commit only inside this disposable scenario copy; the app itself never runs Git write commands.
scenarios.finish_condition: Leave RU/ui.txt active after the synchronization preview and explicit Save, with UI_CAMERA still untranslated/For Review and the translated UI_GIT_NEW row plus both committed EN comments present on disk.
operator_hints: Copy the disposable project root from this dialog. Never run these commands in the source fixture or installed game.
Initialize the disposable copy with: git -C <project-root> init; configure a test user; git -C <project-root> add EN RU KO; git -C <project-root> commit -m 'Manual sync baseline'. Do not add .tzp.
Use any terminal editor for EN/ui.txt, then commit only that file. Git commands are deliberately operator-owned and remain outside TranslationZed-Py.
steps: Copy the disposable project root, initialize a local Git repository there, configure user.name/user.email, add only EN RU KO, and commit the unchanged fixture as `Manual sync baseline`.
Use General -> Synchronize from Git, accept setting current local HEAD as the first baseline, and confirm the app reports that synchronization is ready.

In the terminal editor, change EN/ui.txt so UI_CAMERA becomes `Camera controls`, add `-- camera guidance` directly above it, and append `-- new Git string` plus `UI_GIT_NEW = "New committed string."`; commit only EN/ui.txt.
Use General -> Synchronize from Git again. Confirm the preview shows UI_CAMERA as modified/comments and UI_GIT_NEW as added; keep the proposed For Review mark and apply every resolved item.
Inspect the copied RU/ui.txt before Save. Confirm its bytes still contain the original UI_CAMERA line, no UI_GIT_NEW key, and neither new comment.
Back in the reloaded RU/ui.txt table, confirm UI_CAMERA kept its translation value and is For Review, and UI_GIT_NEW appears as a NEW row. Enter a Russian translation for UI_GIT_NEW.

Use General -> Save, choose Write to file, and apply the NEW-row insertion if prompted. Inspect RU/ui.txt and confirm the existing translation was preserved while both comments and the translated new row were written in EN order.
expected_checks: Only the saved baseline through local committed HEAD is inspected; no remote or Git-management control appears.
The preview exposes the changed source, committed comments, new key, target value, decision, and proposed review status.
Applying the preview changes cache/baseline only and leaves RU/ui.txt unchanged until normal Save.
UI_CAMERA keeps its target value and becomes For Review; UI_GIT_NEW remains an editable NEW row after the affected file refresh.
Normal Save preserves existing target text and writes the chosen comments and translated new row without unrelated rewrites.
